items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 May 2026 10:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 06 May 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the North Sea and low pressure and associated frontal zone to the northwest of Scotland.


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, but force 5 in the east of the area, veering south or southwest 2 to 4 in all waters tomorrow morning and increasing occasionally force 5 in the west of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east overnight.


##Weather##

Fair to start, isolated showers soon developing.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 to start, becoming variable 3 or less Friday morning, settling northerly 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
